description:
*User Story*
As a shopper, I want to add products to my cart from the product page so that I can buy them later.

*Business Value*
Core purchase funnel — increases cart creation and revenue.

*Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin)*
Scenario: Add simple product to cart
  Given I am on a product page of an in-stock item
  When I click "Add to Cart"
  Then the item should appear in my cart with correct price and quantity = 1

Scenario: Add out-of-stock product
  Given the product is out of stock
  When I click "Add to Cart"
  Then I should see an "Out of stock" message and no item is added

Scenario: Add multiple quantities
  Given I select quantity = 3
  When I add the product to my cart
  Then the cart should show quantity = 3 and the correct subtotal

*QA Notes*

* Validate price sync with backend.
* Ensure guest carts persist using cookies/local storage.
